description: Defines a log filter class that processes log messages by passing only the message content to the next log node, ignoring metadata such as priority, tag, and throwable. It implements the LogNode interface and is designed for chaining log processing components.

classes.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
classes.description: A filter class implementing LogNode that passes only log messages, omitting metadata, useful for simple log displays.

methods.name: MessageOnlyLogFilter
methods.description: Constructor that accepts the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes a log message, forwarding only the message content to the next node.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the chain.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode in the chain.
